summary: Sterling Real Estate Trust filed an 8-K to disclose an amendment to its share and unit redemption plans, increasing the aggregate redemption maximum from $75 million to $100 million, and adopting an amendment to its independent trustee stock plan to increase authorized shares from 40,000 to 60,000. These are routine capital plan adjustments, not a special-situation event. There is no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring. The filing reflects standard corporate housekeeping with no material change in control or strategy. No deal terms, premiums, or advisors are involved.
